name: NO_LEFT_TURN_WHITE_SQUARE

rm2-6a_no_left_turn.desc: red annulus with red bar (top-left to bottom-right) over a black left-turn block arrow; 539 outer diameter; annulus/bar widths and arrow geometry only on the 50 grid; multi-colour - symbol carries its own fills

notes: RM2-6A(L) 600 x 600, 25 black border, square corners. Symbol 539 dia centred ('=' margins, 30.5 from the edge). Annulus thickness, bar width and arrow dims are not stated (grid only) so the whole device is one symbol.
